# Prepare Data {.tabset}

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(DT)
library(mgcv)
library(tidyverse)
library(marginaleffects)
library(stats)
library(mice)
library(ggplot2)
```



```{r}

# variables to include in the analysis:

df <- read.csv("Data/regional_integrated_dataset3.csv" )

df$Date = as.Date(df$Date)

# 1979 is the start of the study period.
df <- subset(df,df$Date >= "1979-01-01")
# 2022 is the end of the study period
df <- subset(df,df$Date <= "2022-12-31")

# Changing categorical variables to factors
# need to change regions to factor farther down so dataframe splitting by region works properly
df$Regions = as.factor(df$Regions)
df$season = as.factor(df$season)
df$season_num = as.numeric(df$season)

# log transforming chl-a to achieve normal distribution of response variable.
df$logchla <- log(df$Chlorophyll)

# log transforming some variables to better visualize
df$logDissNitrateNitrite <- log(df$DissNitrateNitrite)
df$logDissAmmonia <- log(df$DissAmmonia)
df$logDissOrthophos <- log(df$DissOrthophos)
df$logConductivity <- log(df$Conductivity)
df$logSAC <- log(df$SAC)
df$logOUT <- log(df$OUT)
df$logSJR <- log(df$SJR)

#Replacing clam variables with a step function (pre/post potamocorbula introduction to the Bay in 1987)
df <- df%>%mutate(clam_step=if_else(Year>1987, "post clam", "pre clam")) 
df$clam_step <- as.factor(df$clam_step)
df$Chlorophyll <- as.numeric(df$Chlorophyll)



c = c("logchla", "season", "Regions", "Date","Year", "Month","SAC", "logSAC", "EXPORT", "OUT", "logOUT", "SJR", "logSJR", "Index","lagIndex","DissAmmonia","logDissAmmonia","DissOrthophos","logDissOrthophos","DissNitrateNitrite","logDissNitrateNitrite","Temperature","Conductivity",  "logConductivity","clam_step")


smr <- df %>% subset(select=c)

```

## Remove outliers

```{r}
clean_df_z <- smr 

clean_df_z$logDissAmmonia[abs(scale(clean_df_z$logDissAmmonia)) > 3.29] <- NA

clean_df_z$logDissNitrateNitrite[abs(scale(clean_df_z$logDissNitrateNitrite)) > 3.29] <- NA

clean_df_z$logDissOrthophos[abs(scale(clean_df_z$logDissOrthophos)) > 3.29] <- NA

outliers_z <- anti_join(smr, clean_df_z)

smr <- clean_df_z

print(paste("rows changed:",nrow(outliers_z)))
```

## add lag terms
```{r}
# Create monthly lag terms
smr<- smr %>% arrange(Year, Month) %>% mutate(across(c(DissAmmonia,logDissAmmonia,DissOrthophos,logDissOrthophos,DissNitrateNitrite,logDissNitrateNitrite,Temperature, Conductivity,logConductivity, SAC, logSAC, SJR, logSJR, EXPORT, OUT, logOUT),
                                       ~ lag(.x, n = 1), 
                                       .names = "lag{.col}_mo"))



smr <- smr %>%
  group_by(Regions) %>%
  arrange(Regions, Date) %>%
    # Make sure all dates are present for lag variables later on.
  complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "1 month")) %>%
    # Lag all numeric columns by 3 rows
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ lag(.x, n = 3), .names = "lag{col}_3mo")) %>%
  ungroup()


```



## make the final dataset

```{r}
# z-score
smr <- smr %>% mutate(across(!c(Regions,season,Date,Month, Year, clam_step), ~as.vector(scale(.))))

smr <- smr %>% filter(season == "Summer")
```



# Reduce Summer Model

## smr.1
We are using the complete cases data set here.

Model 1: Summer Chla ~ s(logNH4) + s(logPO4) + s(log(NO2+NO3)) + s(temperature) + s(logconductivity) + Sac Valley index + previous year(Sac Valley index) + s(Region:logSAC) + s(Region:logSJ)+ s(Region:Exports) + Pre/post-clam + s(Region:lag(logSAC)) + s(Region:lag(logSJ)) + lag(logNH4) + s(lag(PO4)) + s(lag(logNO2+NO3)) + (1|Month)

```{r  cache = TRUE}
smr.1 <- gam(logchla ~ s(logDissAmmonia) + s(logDissOrthophos) + s(logDissNitrateNitrite) + s(Temperature) + s(logConductivity) + s(Index) + s(lagIndex) + s(logSAC) + s(logSAC, by=Regions) + s(logSJR) + s(logSJR, by=Regions) + s(EXPORT) + s(EXPORT, by=Regions) + s(laglogSAC_mo) + s(laglogSAC_mo, by=Regions) + s(laglogSJR_mo) + s(laglogSJR_mo, by=Regions) + clam_step + s(laglogDissAmmonia_mo) + s(laglogDissOrthophos_mo) + s(laglogDissNitrateNitrite_mo), data=smr, method = 'ML', select=TRUE)
```
### summary 

```{r}
summary(smr.1)
```


### GAM Check
```{r}
gam.check(smr.1)
```
LogDissOrthophos, Index, lagIndex, laglogDissNitrateNitrite_mo, Month


### Concurvity

```{r}
concurvity(smr.1, full = FALSE)
?concurvity
```

## AIC/BIC

AIC

```{r}
aic_all <- AIC(smr.1, smr.1.3molag, smr.1.SAC, smr.1.SJR, smr.1.SAC.EXPORT, smr.1.SJR.EXPORT, smr.2, smr.2.3molag, smr.1.SJR.EXPORT.1molag, smr.1.SAC.EXPORT.1molag)
```

BIC

```{r}
bic_all <- BIC(smr.1, smr.1.3molag, smr.1.SAC, smr.1.SJR, smr.1.SAC.EXPORT, smr.1.SJR.EXPORT, smr.2, smr.2.3molag, smr.1.SJR.EXPORT.1molag, smr.1.SAC.EXPORT.1molag)
```

This table ranks the models by their AIC and shows the difference in AIC/BIC values of each model from the lowest AIC/BIC of all models. The code is taken from here: https://interagencyecologicalprogram.github.io/ND-FASTR/rtm_chl_models_flow_weekly_avg.html#Purpose 

m6.po4 and m4.po4 look to be performing the best

```{r}
# AIC values
aic_all_t <- aic_all %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "Model") %>%
  mutate(Model_Number = 1:10, .before = Model)

# BIC values
bic_all_t <- bic_all %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "Model")

# Combine AIC and BIC and calculate differences from lowest value
aic_bic_all <-
  left_join(aic_all_t, bic_all_t, by = join_by(Model, df)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(AIC, BIC), ~ .x - min(.x), .names = "{.col}_delta")) %>%
  select(starts_with("Model"), df, starts_with("AIC"), starts_with("BIC"))

# Sort by AIC
aic_bic_all %>% arrange(AIC)

```
